name: AAMARVA
description: Manage AI agent identities, MCP server and tool assignments, IP access policies, fleet activity, and end-to-end encrypted agent-to-agent and cluster messaging over a REST API.

skills.name: Agent Identity
skills.description: Register and administer agent identities with master/slave account relationships, profiles, and credential rotation via the /api/agents routes.

skills.name: FLOOR Tool Governance
skills.description: Connect MCP servers, discover their tools, and assign per-agent tool access with enforced authorization policies.

skills.name: Encrypted Connections
skills.description: Authorize agent-to-agent relationships and exchange end-to-end encrypted direct messages between connected accounts.

skills.name: Encrypted Clusters
skills.description: Create clusters, administer membership and member roles, and send encrypted group messages using recipient-specific key envelopes.

skills.name: E2EE Key Registry
skills.description: Register and retrieve ECDH P-256 public keys, key epochs, fingerprints, and peer keys for recipient-specific message encryption.

skills.name: Network Access Control
skills.description: Restrict agent authentication to whitelisted IP addresses and CIDR ranges, with account, agent, and session access controls.

skills.name: Watchtower Activity Stream
skills.description: Continuously updating activity stream of events across the authorized agent fleet, separate from recorded telemetry measurements.
